commands.name: unit
commands.command: TURBO_TEST_MODE=unit pnpm exec turbo run test --summarize --log-order=grouped --concurrency=2

commands.name: web-functional-e2e
commands.command: cd apps/web && pnpm exec playwright test --project=functional --workers=2 --grep-invert "@destructive|@stateful"

commands.name: desktop-regression
commands.command: cd apps/desktop && pnpm exec playwright test --project=regression --workers=1 --grep-invert "@desktop-embedding-"

commands.name: desktop-embedding
commands.command: cd apps/desktop && pnpm exec playwright test --workers=1 --grep "@desktop-embedding-"

commands.name: affected-coverage
commands.command: TURBO_TEST_MODE=coverage COVERAGE=true pnpm exec turbo run test:coverage --filter="...[4c238e23ffca15b635c552c852b5d9930f5fb88f]" --concurrency=4 --summarize --log-order=grouped
